# QR decoder provenance

`jsQR-1.4.0.js` is the unmodified browser distribution `dist/jsQR.js` from [jsqr 1.4.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr/v/1.4.0), [upstream source](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR). It is distributed under the accompanying Apache 2.0 license. The package integrity is `sha512-dxLob7q65Xg2DvstYkRpkYtmKm2sPJ9oFhrhmudT1dZvNFFTlroai3AWSpLey/w5vMcLBXRgOJsbXpdN9HzU/A==`.

It is served from the same origin and loaded only in the short-lived QR worker. Do not substitute a CDN request or install a remote decoder at runtime.
